text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the morning, in front of the school gates, a clamorous—
or rather, an incredibly energetic voice could be heard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hit with a greeting delivered at point-blank range at explosive volume, I reflexively stumbled back several steps.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: YES! It is the Greeting Bakushin Campaign!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's a student council-led campaign to promote greetings.
Meant to raise students' awareness regarding proper etiquette.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: That said, it was originally supposed to be just a light "promotional campaign" involving putting up posters to encourage greetings, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Rather than gentle promotion, a grand Bakushin!!
Action above all else! That is what came to your Class President's mind!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Arrival at school—Instant—Class President!
Named the "Greeting Bakushin Campaign"!
With this, the importance of greetings will surely get across!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...So you see, as this is technically part of
a student council initiative,
I came here to supervise, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No... Well,
you'll understand if you just watch.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, another spectator has arrived?!
Very well, then!
Behold the Class Rep's Bakushin Greeting—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes wide open and watch closely!!
BAKUSHIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to observe
Sakura Bakushin O's "Greeting Bakushin Campaign," but—

text_block_list.name: Timid Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Eep?!
Wh-What are you doing all of a sudden?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's the Greeting Bakushin Campaign!
You over there, as well! Tsu!!

text_block_list.name: Sleepy Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't jump out out of nowhere!
Staring at me from that close is just...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
The greeting promotion campaign used to have...
a much calmer vibe before, didn't it...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...She certainly has enthusiasm, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's this?! It seems my passion fired up
everyone's hearts right as they arrived at school?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, it pains me to say this, but...
To be frank... they are put off by you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Her motivation comes through loud and clear,
so I'd like to let her continue, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Intimidating the students
defeats the entire purpose.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the essence of my greeting!
My Bakushin enthusiasm!
Is still sorely lacking, you say?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Bakushin O is utterly serious.
Isn't there some way for her to convey her enthusiasm
without troubling the other students...?!
choice_data_list: How about expressing it with gestures?
Why not come up with a catchy slogan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that instead of shouting even louder,
she could incorporate gestures and body language!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see, body language!
With that, we can leap over language barriers—
the birth of the Universal Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Good! Morn! Ing!!
Good! Morn! Ing!!
Good moooorning to you all!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All right, lower your voice in proportion to your movements...!
Keep moving in place as much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...We'll keep you under observation for now.
Report immediately if any problems arise.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Boy, I was startled when you said
they were put off by me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As expected, Bakushin saves the world!
This marks the beginning of the
Universal Greeting Bakushin Campaign!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I suggested that by having everyone memorize an approachable slogan,
she could convey the importance of greetings
without having to shout so loudly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Me, create a slogan?!
What a heavy responsibility!
Truly a duty fit only for the Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ..."Bakushin"... "Morning"!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
It expresses the spirit of greeting
and the spirit of Bakushin simultaneously!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Bakushin Morning"!!
"Bakushin Morrrrning"!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about this...?
I don't sense any change in the noisiness, though...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, we'll keep you under observation for now.
Notify me immediately if any issues arise.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
All right, thanks to this slogan,
I've received tentative approval!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Continuing at this pace—!!
I shall deliver Bakushin energy
to the school gates every morning!!
